title: Warranty Coverage Service Terms: Remedy by Visit or Shipment, and Visit and Shipping Charges
content:
These service terms of Warranty Coverage govern how an approved claim is remedied and what a visit or shipment carries. Some sentences are in force and three have been withdrawn.

## In force

1. An approved claim is remedied by a technician visit offered within the plan's visit window, or, for a parts-only approval the customer chooses to fit themselves, by shipping the parts within the plan's shipping window.
2. A visit inside the labor term carries no labor or trip charge for the covered repair.
3. A parts shipment to the customer carries the plan's shipping fee once per shipment.
4. Discontinued parts are replaced with the nearest current-production equivalent.

The visit window, shipping window and shipping fee are the figures of each plan's appointment and parts schedules.

### Cases (hypothetical)
- A parts-only approval where the customer fits the part: the parts ship within the plan's shipping window, and each shipment carries the plan's shipping fee once.
- A covered repair made at a visit inside the labor term: no labor charge and no trip charge.
- A discontinued sash lock: replaced with the nearest current-production equivalent.

## Withdrawn — no longer in force

The three sentences below are **no longer in force**. The current basis for the trip charge, for the labor billed on a visit, and for the fee on a missed visit replaces them; they are reproduced only so the withdrawn wording is recognised:

> A visit outside the labor term carries the plan's out-of-term trip charge plus labor at the plan's hourly rate for the billable hours, which are the hours on site with the minimum applied and any time beyond the minimum rounded up to the billing increment.

> When the technician finds no covered defect, the plan's no-defect trip charge applies even inside the labor term.

> A visit where nobody gives access within the wait time is a no-show; the no-shows of a registration up to the plan's free count carry no fee and each later one carries the plan's no-show fee.

The withdrawal concerns these handling sentences only. The plan figures they mention — the out-of-term and no-defect trip charges, the hourly rate, the minimum and billing increment, the wait time, the free no-show count and the no-show fee — remain the valid figures of each plan's rate card and appointment schedule.

superseded_clauses: A visit outside the labor term carries the plan's out-of-term trip charge plus labor at the plan's hourly rate for the billable hours, which are the hours on site with the minimum applied and any time beyond the minimum rounded up to the billing increment.
When the technician finds no covered defect, the plan's no-defect trip charge applies even inside the labor term.

A visit where nobody gives access within the wait time is a no-show; the no-shows of a registration up to the plan's free count (warranty_msr_no_shows) carry no fee and each later one carries the plan's no-show fee.
